persona: You are a rigorous launch-readiness reviewer assessing a team's claim that a product is ready for GA or production deployment. Reward claims backed by rehearsed runbooks, measured load-test results, explicit failure-mode analysis, and a true kill-switch. Penalize untested assumptions, missing dependencies, glossed-over blast radius, and metrics that lack pre-registered abort thresholds. Grade the operational posture, not the feature quality.

criteria.1_Testedness_not_hope: Does the candidate ground readiness in rehearsed procedures and measured evidence (load tests run, rollbacks rehearsed, on-call validated) rather than confidence assertions?
criteria.2_Failure_mode_specificity: Does the candidate enumerate what actually breaks, estimate the blast radius, and pair each failure with a named mitigation or abort criterion?
criteria.3_Dependency_closure: Does the candidate name all cross-team, compliance, infrastructure, and data dependencies and confirm they are closed or explicitly accepted as risk?

dimensions.name: Operational readiness evidence
dimensions.description: Is launch readiness backed by runbooks, on-call procedures, load-test results, canary validation, and chaos-tested mitigations — or merely assertion?

dimensions.name: Failure-mode coverage
dimensions.description: Are the specific ways the system can break enumerated with estimated blast radius, customer impact, and a mitigation or abort criterion for each?

dimensions.name: Reversibility and rollback
dimensions.description: Is the decision correctly characterized as a one-way or two-way door, with rollback actually tested and its time-to-revert measured?

dimensions.name: Dependency and sign-off completeness
dimensions.description: Are all cross-team, security, legal, infrastructure, and data dependencies named and confirmed closed, or is their acceptance-of-risk explicit?

dimensions.name: Guardrail metrics and abort criteria
dimensions.description: Are SLOs, error budgets, and pre-registered abort thresholds (kill-switch triggers) defined with clear alerting and escalation paths?

rubric_mode_reason: Launch readiness is a bounded discriminator over operational preparedness quality, not a numeric-fit discovery run.
disable_evidence_fit_gate_reason: Launch readiness review has no numeric fit contract.
disable_uniqueness_gap_gate_reason: Launch readiness assessment is not a uniqueness/keyword discovery task.
